title: Resilient OTLP -> Jaeger/Tempo export pipeline with buffering and dynamic sampling
creator: Asha Patel
description: Background: We need a durable, low-latency pipeline that exports traces from our OTLP ingest layer to downstream tracing backends (Jaeger and Tempo). Current PoC exports are fragile under bursty load and do not expose exporter-level metrics or transparent sampling controls. Goal: implement a production-ready OTLP exporter wiring that supports client-side batching/buffering, retry/backoff, transparent dynamic sampling controls surfaced in Console, and clear observability (exporter latency/error metrics) so we can route to Jaeger for low-volume debug traces and Tempo for long-retention aggregate traces.
acceptance_criteria: 1) OTLP collector/config can be switched between Jaeger and Tempo endpoints via config/Console toggles without agent changes. 2) Exporter exposes metrics: exporter_requests_total, exporter_errors_total, exporter_export_latency_p50/p95. 3) Buffering prevents downstream outage from dropping customer traces for at least 2 minutes at configured rate; test added. 4) Dynamic sampling rule (rate and tail-sampling) can be pushed from Console and applied within 30s. 5) End-to-end integration tests against a Tempo test cluster pass in CI.
technical_approach: - Update collector config to add two exporter profiles: jaeger_thrift_http and tempo_otlp_grpc with TLS and mTLS support. - Implement a resilient export pipeline component in the ingest path that: (a) batches spans by tenant and model/service, (b) uses bounded in-memory ring buffer + disk-backed overflow for bursts, (c) applies async retry with exponential backoff and jitter, and (d) emits per-exporter metrics. - Add a dynamic sampling controller that subscribes to Console (via control plane API) and updates sampler rules via xDS-like config refresh. - Wire trace-context propagation tests across services. - Provide a Console UI toggle and rollout flags for per-tenant routing to Jaeger vs Tempo.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Buffering on disk could leak PII if not encrypted; mitigation: encrypt overflow files with KMS keys and enforce retention/rotation. Risk: Too-aggressive sampling could hide regressions; mitigation: default conservative sampling with ability to ramp via canary. Risk: Exporter overload could delay API responses; mitigation: ensure export pipeline is decoupled from critical path and backpressure uses enqueue/drop policies with metrics.
testing_plan: - Unit tests for batcher/overflow behavior. - Integration tests in CI that spin up a dev Tempo instance and a Jaeger collector; validate span fidelity, attributes, and latency under 1k/s synthetic load. - Chaos test: kill exporter endpoint and validate buffer retention and retry behavior. - Add end-to-end smoke to gated CI that verifies Console sampling changes take effect.
observability_changes: Add dashboards and alerts: 1) Tracing Exporter Overview: exporter_requests_total (by exporter), exporter_errors_total (by error type), exporter_queue_depth, exporter_disk_overflow_bytes, export_latency_p50/p95. 2) Latency/Error dashboard rows for high exporter latency and error spikes with links to failed-span examples. Alerts: exporter_error_rate > 1% for 5m, exporter_queue_depth > 75% for 3m, disk_overflow > 90% capacity.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature branch + integration tests. 2) Internal canary: enable for infra and internal tenants (10%) for 48h. 3) Gradually increase to 50% and then 100% over a week while monitoring exporter metrics and Console error dashboards. 4) If errors spike or disk overflow increases >10% from baseline, rollback routing flag and open incident playbook.
rollback_criteria: - exporter_errors_total increases >5x baseline for 10m OR - disk_overflow_bytes grows >150% and sustained for 15m OR - tail traces are being dropped per sampling telemetry. In any of these, flip Console toggle to previous routing and disable disk overflow (drop-on-full) policy while investigating.
notes: Design doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OBS/pages/OTLP+Exporter+Resiliency. Implementation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2435. Integration test harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/testing/tree/main/tempo-e2e. Follow-up work: per-tenant retention policies and cross-tenant isolation in exporter buffer.
